summary: Compose the N2 NBI initialization slice: the ndmc neutral-rate normalization runs first, then exactly one of the two source-mutually-exclusive trajectory branches - the mc_nbi source-plane ray with optional finite beam-grid entry handoff, or the mc_nbi_cell cell-directed ray with divergence weight.

identity.relation: Ordered branching DAG: injection_normalization -> {source_ray -> energy_velocity -> (optional) beam_grid_entry | cell_directed_ray}. The source_ray branch consumes the same accepted unit ray in the velocity scaling edge (source_ray.unit_ray_beam -> energy_velocity.unit_ray); the optional beam_grid_entry node maps the accepted source point/unit ray to the finite-grid entry/exit handoff; the cell_directed branch aliases the cell leaf's velocity and weight. The branches are mutually exclusive; normalization is a shared predecessor, not a numeric data edge into the ray geometry (the source's nneutrals-first order is scheduling).
identity.direction: NBI power/energy/component fractions + cell volume + one branch's explicit geometric state (with caller random variates) -> neutral rates, initial-state source-rate projection, and the branch's ray/velocity/acceptance (and optional grid entry) outputs
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM NBI轨迹初始化图 caller-random paths (framework node N2 neutral_beam_source_sampling), composed from already-integrated SciRel leaves. The saved graph's serial utilities.f90 two-word RNG modes (seed, captured per-event state, 1000-rejection fallback) are controlled runtime glue, not a scientific relation; consistent with the NBI leaf family's caller-owned randomness convention they are a declared non-ported boundary and their state keys are rejected.
identity.model: composition of the named SciRel leaves following the saved graph's node/edge contract; no new scientific rule is introduced in glue
identity.geometry: one frozen NBI configuration snapshot; beam coordinates xyz/uvw per the leaf contracts
identity.coordinates: positions in cm, velocities in cm/s, angles in radians, rates in s^-1 and cm^-3 s^-1 per the leaf contracts
identity.boundary: sampling_mode exactly source_ray or cell_directed; the chosen branch's state mapping is required and complete; serial-RNG state keys are rejected as a declared non-ported runtime boundary; N1 in_plasma masking, MPI/OpenMP scheduling and N3 transport remain explicit framework edges
assumptions: The caller supplies a frozen NBI configuration snapshot and caller-owned random variates for the source_ray branch.
Rejection resampling stays with the caller, who resupplies variates and consumes the accepted flag.

inputs.name: injected_power_mw
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; zero is legal and yields an all-zero normalization.

inputs.name: current_fractions
inputs.description: Full/half/third component current fractions, axis order 1/2/3.
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative, at least one positive.

inputs.name: source_ray_state
inputs.description: Complete explicit source-plane, optics, aperture and coordinate state for the source_ray branch, including the caller variates source_uniform/divergence_normal plus injection_speed_cm_s and energy_component; exact operator keys otherwise.
inputs.constraints: Required iff sampling_mode='source_ray'; serial-RNG state keys (source_serial_rng_seed, source_rng_state, source_fallback_axis_beam) are rejected.

inputs.name: cell_directed_state
inputs.description: Complete explicit cell, source, optics, aperture and coordinate state for the cell_directed branch; exact nbi_cell_directed_ray keys.

inputs.name: beam_grid_entry_state
inputs.description: Optional finite beam-grid center and full lengths for the source_ray entry/exit handoff.
inputs.constraints: Keys grid_center_cm and grid_lengths_cm per the intersection leaf; only consumed on the source_ray branch.

outputs.name: total_neutral_rate_s_inv
outputs.description: Total neutral rate after the three-component energy weighting.

outputs.name: component_neutral_rate_s_inv
outputs.description: Per-component neutral rates projected from current_fractions.

outputs.name: initial_state_rate_per_volume_cm_inv3_s_inv
outputs.description: Per-component source rate per declared volume (the saved graph's initial-state density projection).

outputs.name: energy_weight_factor
outputs.description: The normalization leaf's energy weight factor.

outputs.name: source_beam_cm
outputs.description: Accepted source-plane point in beam coordinates (source_ray branch; null on the cell_directed branch).

outputs.name: unit_ray_beam
outputs.description: Accepted ray's unit direction in beam coordinates (source_ray branch; null on the cell_directed branch).

outputs.name: velocity_cm_s
outputs.description: Selected energy-component birth velocity (source_ray: scaled accepted unit ray; cell_directed: cell leaf's beam-grid uvw velocity).

outputs.name: accepted
outputs.description: Aperture (source_ray) or target-cell branch acceptance flag.

outputs.name: trajectory_weight
outputs.description: Cell-directed divergence probability-density weight (cell_directed branch; null on the source_ray branch).
outputs.constraints: Finite and positive on accepted cell rays.

outputs.name: initial_grid_entry_cm
outputs.description: Finite-grid entry from the optional handoff (source_ray branch with beam_grid_entry_state; null otherwise).

outputs.name: grid_exit_cm
outputs.description: Finite-grid exit paired with initial_grid_entry_cm; null when the handoff is absent or on the cell_directed branch.

outputs.name: grid_intersection_length_cm
outputs.description: Chord length inside the finite grid; null when the handoff is absent or on the cell_directed branch; zero means no distinct pair.

outputs.name: intersects_beam_grid
outputs.description: Whether the finite grid has a valid entry/exit pair; null when the handoff is absent or on the cell_directed branch.

preconditions: A frozen NBI configuration snapshot with explicit caller-owned random variates for the source_ray branch.
supported: Deterministic NBI trajectory initialization for downstream neutral-population transport consumption.
excluded: Serial RNG replay and the 1000-rejection fallback (declared non-ported runtime boundary), in_plasma masking, MPI/OpenMP scheduling, N3 transport and whole-program parity.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs is not a mapping, when a required top-level key is missing, when sampling_mode is not source_ray or cell_directed, when the chosen branch's state mapping is missing or incomplete, or when a serial-RNG state key is supplied (declared non-ported boundary).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Propagates the composed leaves' fail-closed ValueError contracts (normalization overflow gates, source-ray norm/finite gates, velocity scaling gates, cell-ray weight gates, intersection finite gates).
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the graph executes each node exactly once.

nodes.description: Form the marker-loop neutral-rate normalization first: total and per-component rates and the declared-volume initial-state projection, shared by both sampling branches.
Construct the mc_nbi source-plane ray from the caller's uniform/normal variates and test every aperture; executed only on the source_ray branch.
Read the caller-declared injection_speed_cm_s and energy_component keys out of source_ray_state; no scientific transformation.
Scale the same accepted unit ray by the injection speed over the Float32 energy-component divisor; source_ray branch only.

Optional finite-grid entry/exit handoff from the accepted source point and unit ray; runs only when beam_grid_entry_state is supplied on the source_ray branch. Follows the intersection leaf's source-ordered infinite-line face-pair semantics (no forward-only guarantee; see its identity.relation). The N1 in_plasma check remains outside this graph.
The mc_nbi_cell cell-targeted ray with aperture acceptance and Gaussian divergence weight; executed only on the cell_directed branch.

execution.ordering: Run the normalization first (the source's nneutrals-first order is scheduling, not a numeric data edge into the ray geometry); then execute exactly one branch selected by sampling_mode: source_ray constructs and accepts the source-plane ray, projects the speed/component keys, scales the same accepted unit ray, and optionally intersects the finite grid; cell_directed runs the cell leaf. Each node executes at most once.
branches: sampling_mode == 'source_ray': normalization -> source_ray -> energy_velocity -> optional beam_grid_entry; source_beam_cm, unit_ray_beam, accepted and grid outputs are produced and trajectory_weight is null.
sampling_mode == 'cell_directed': normalization -> cell_directed_ray; velocity_cm_s, accepted and trajectory_weight are produced and the source-ray/grid outputs are null.
Any other sampling_mode value raises ValueError; the serial RNG state keys raise ValueError as a declared non-ported runtime boundary.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns no evolving state; one frozen NBI configuration snapshot per call, with caller-owned random variates and rejection resampling.
execution.failure_propagation: Child leaf ValueError contracts propagate directly; there is no fallback geometry or partial result.

example.description: The source_ray branch on an identity basis: normalization precedes the accepted centerline ray and its velocity; the RNG boundary key is rejected.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import initialize_nbi_trajectory
result = initialize_nbi_trajectory({
    'sampling_mode': 'source_ray',
    'injected_power_mw': 2.0, 'injection_energy_kev': 80.0,
    'current_fractions': [0.5, 0.3, 0.2], 'beam_grid_cell_volume_cm3': 125.0,
    'source_ray_state': {
        'source_uniform': [0.5, 0.5], 'divergence_normal': [0.0, 0.0],
        'source_shape': 1, 'half_width_y_cm': 2.0, 'half_width_z_cm': 3.0,
        'focus_y_cm': 100.0, 'focus_z_cm': 100.0,
        'divergence_y_rad': 0.1, 'divergence_z_rad': 0.1,
        'aperture_distance_cm': [5.0], 'aperture_shape': [1],
        'aperture_offset_y_cm': [0.0], 'aperture_offset_z_cm': [0.0],
        'aperture_half_width_y_cm': [2.0], 'aperture_half_width_z_cm': [2.0],
        'beam_basis': np.eye(3), 'beam_source_cm': [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        'injection_speed_cm_s': 1.0e8, 'energy_component': 1,
    },
})
assert result['accepted'] and result['trajectory_weight'] is None
assert np.allclose(result['unit_ray_beam'], [1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
assert np.isclose(result['total_neutral_rate_s_inv'], 2.0e6 / (8.0e4 * 1.602176634e-19 * (0.5 + 0.15 + 0.2 / 3.0)), rtol=1e-12)
try:
    initialize_nbi_trajectory({'sampling_mode': 'source_ray', 'injected_power_mw': 2.0, 'injection_energy_kev': 80.0, 'current_fractions': [0.5, 0.3, 0.2], 'beam_grid_cell_volume_cm3': 125.0, 'source_ray_state': {'source_serial_rng_seed': 42}})
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('serial RNG state keys are a declared non-ported boundary')
example.expected: The centerline source_ray branch composes normalization, ray and velocity; serial-RNG state keys raise ValueError.

scope: Composition order: normalization precedes both branches; the same accepted unit ray feeds the velocity scaling and the optional grid handoff.
